definitions.A: native particles PF + external SciPy Nelder-Mead
definitions.B: new particles.iterated_filtering.if2_step initialization + same external SciPy Nelder-Mead

IF2_endpoint: mean of last accepted complete pass; not best perturbed likelihood
train_keys: Disjoint uint32 blocks: 24981000+100000*task_id+50000*stage+call, task_id=(start*2+rep)*2+arm; A0/B1; stage0 IF2 single seed followed by continuous RNG, stage1 NM fresh seed per call; assert call<50000. All future possible blocks separated from scoring root94981000.

external_NM.initial_simplex: SciPy default, identical rule for A/B

late_calls: fully charged, never accept late parameter/cloud; IF2 overshoot reduces remaining total NM budget
failure: save traceback/full cloud/RNG/last finite parameter and cost; no retry; independent score retains failure flag
endpoint_selection: best native PF training objective finished by total deadline; independent scores never consulted
